info.title: Factory Partner Portal tool layer
info.description: One service with two doors. This document covers the web door. Agents use the MCP door at `POST /mcp`, which publishes the same actions with the same schemas, generated from the same list, and is discoverable at runtime through `tools/list`. This document is generated from the service's own definitions, so it cannot disagree with the code. Sandbox only.
